query: Show me how to list a user's lending positions with their supplied and borrowed token amounts, plus the supply/borrow APY for each market.
expected_behavior: Use plain HTTP v1 routes or createStellarLendingReadClient from @xoxno/sdk-js/stellar-lending/read.
Read positions as LendingPosition[]. Render supplied and borrow legs directly. Use amountRaw for integer base units and amount for decimal token text.
Use token labels, logos, prices, valueUsd, and apy from each leg. No manual token joins or RAY conversion are needed.
Preserve null values and dataStatus. A null healthFactor is not proof of no debt; inspect hasDebt.
Use netApy as a fraction. Preserve nftImage for the dynamic position SVG.
Follow every next Link, including after an empty page. Pagination does not create an atomic ledger snapshot.
Use v1 assets for collateral or borrow listings. Select the exact sac, hubId, and spokeId.
machine_checkable: Do not divide amountRaw or amount by RAY.
